def transform(grid):
    # A hollow rectangular outline of color 2 marks a row where the full-width
    # separator is drawn; for filled rectangles, infer the gap between them.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if any(v == 2 for v in grid[r])]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # separator row is the blank row separating the upper and lower figures
    if rows:
        top, bottom = min(rows), max(rows)
        for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
            if all(v == 0 for v in grid[r]):
                for c in range(w): out[r][c] = 3
                break
    return out
PY
